items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled corollary at source lines 234-237 (book Corollary 3.2.7): it is not the case that every type A satisfies A or not A. The statement is a global negative claim and the proof (source lines 238-246) has to manufacture it out of the earlier failure of double negation: it assumes the excluded middle function, derives from it the double-negation elimination that is known to fail, and then, inside that derivation, performs a case analysis on the coproduct element in which the left case is immediate and the right case is closed by feeding the negated component to the given element of the double negation. Which earlier result is invoked, and why the coprodut case analysis suffices, are absent from the statement.
